title: Enforce an explicit HKDF input contract on Windows
goal: Reject oversized key-derivation input before deriving a key when a protocol must work with Windows CNG, preserving accepted keying material, salt and context bytes.

selectionNotes: Reject oversized key-derivation input before deriving a key when a protocol must work with Windows CNG, preserving accepted keying material, salt and context bytes.

Executed Windows x64 build26200, bcrypt10.0.26100.1, SHA-256 only: raw and canonical IKM/PRK 2048/2049, independent HMAC outputs, RFC5869 vector and preserved inputs; no all-hash/all-Windows or final-GA claim.
